project.description: The goal of the project is to demonstrate the feasibility of increasing the accuracy and sensitivity of an atomic 87Rb magnetometer that is immune to the nonlinear Zeeman splitting error by the excitation of high-order atomic coherences (transverse components of the multipole moments). The proposed method will provide a read-out signal that is linearly dependent on the external magnetic field. We will exploit the knowledge and skills obtained in the University of Latvia about light-atom interactions in external fields to advance the development of quantum sensors for magnetic fields, specifically when the earth’s magnetic field is the background.
